## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Refactoring (code cleanup, performance improvement)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Testing Checklist
- [ ] All unit tests pass (`python -m unittest discover tests`)
- [ ] Audio recording tested with real microphone
- [ ] UI tested on 100% and 125% Windows DPI scaling
- [ ] Non-destructive file handling verified
